name: web-mechanic-services-site-on-laptop-in-garage-scene
title: Dark mobile-mechanic website on a laptop among car tools in a workshop
whatItIs: A laptop on a dark workbench with a mug, tools and a cloth, a sports car in the background. The screen shows a dark page with a blue-highlighted headline 'Professional Mobile Mechanics', blue and green buttons and a photo card.
whatItMeans: Practical and moody; the site looks at home in the workshop it advertises.
techniques: Stage the mockup in the service's real environment.
Match dark UI to dark scene with a blue accent.
Use props like tools to add narrative.
Keep the screen readable with high contrast type.

vocabulary.definition: Placing a mockup in a scene from the client's industry.
A key word coloured in the accent.
An interface with a dark background.
